semantic_meaning: Splits the frame into 'surface' (what people think is happening) versus 'structure' (what the system actually does).
when_to_use: When pivoting from narrative surface to mechanism structure
Before showing an x-ray layer reveal
when_not_to_use: If surface and structure are identical (no reveal)
When it would distract from the central claim

animation_behavior.description: Surface pane slides aside/defocuses; structure pane sharpens; structural routes appear in cyan; leverage highlight in amber.

state_beats.label: structure_emerge
state_beats.meaningful_change: Structure pane sharpens; cyan scaffolding appears.

state_beats.label: surface_fade
state_beats.meaningful_change: Surface pane defocuses; attention moves to structure.

expected_outputs: A clear surface/structure contrast with motion-driven reveal
validation_notes: Must lead into a mechanism view, not end as a static slide.
